key_insight: GPU-based meet-in-the-middle compilation finds Fibonacci-anyon braids in the CNOT equivalence class with leakage and class error both around 10⁻¹⁰ at length 69.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports low-leakage two-qubit gate compilation for Fibonacci-anyon quantum hardware while managing the rapid growth of braid search spaces.
method: Exhaustively search the full positive five-generator alphabet through length 21.
Reach length 72 by narrowing to three-generator, boundary-σ₃, and palindromic braids and using Garside left normal form.
Derive leakage bounds and limiting distributions to compare exhaustive search with random sampling.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports leakage around 10⁻³ and CNOT-class error around 10⁻⁸ in the full search through length 21, and both around 10⁻¹⁰ for a length-69 braid in a restricted search.
watch_item: Longer-length results rely on restricted braid families, and low CNOT-class error does not alone establish a hardware-ready exact CNOT implementation.
paper_title: Meet-in-the-Middle Compilation of the $[\mathrm{CNOT}]$ Class with Fibonacci Anyons
